_meta.description: Consolidated verified-numbers report for CourtVision README claims. All numbers reproducible from committed code + free public data.
_meta.reproducibility: Run `python data/external/historical_lines/fetch_external_history.py` then the scripts referenced under each result block.

playoffs_2024.description: L10 rolling-avg predictor vs real DK/FanDuel/MGM/BetRivers closing lines, 2024 NBA playoffs (Apr 21 - May 24).

season_2025_26_prod_stack.description: Production model stack (walk-forward OOF predictions) vs real DK/FanDuel/MGM closing lines, 2025-26 regular season + 2026 playoffs (Jan 28 - May 8 2026).

season_2025_26_l10_baseline.description: L10 baseline (same predictor as 2024 playoffs) vs same DK/FD/MGM lines, for prod-stack comparison.
season_2025_26_l10_baseline.prod_stack_lift: prod stack vs L10: +2.17pp beat-rate, +3.54pp ROI

prop_models_walk_forward_mae.description: Walk-forward MAE @ q50 on holdout. Verified via scripts/verify_production_mae.py — 6/7 stats within +/-0.01 of stated claim; PTS within +0.04.

win_probability.description: 5-way NNLS stack (XGB + LGB + LR + MLP + NB). Verified via scripts/verify_winprob.py — within tolerance.
win_probability.note: XGB zeroed by NNLS autonomously on validation (member selection by gate, not by mandate)

in_game_lift.description: endQ3 in-play MAE vs prod pregame MAE on 550-game retro (local) + 46-game RunPod re-run.
in_game_lift.verdict: endQ3 wins 7/7 stats on local 550-game retro; 5/5 on RunPod 46-game subset (REB/FG3M/STL/BLK/TOV available).

actionable_findings_from_real_vegas: AST and FG3M show consistent edge across both seasons against real DK/FD/MGM: AST +7.22% ROI on 863 bets in 2025-26 regular season alone.
PTS and REB at sharp regular-season DK/FD/MGM closes lose to vig — calibration is the next pin.
Playoff markets (2024) are systematically softer than regular-season markets (2025-26): same beat rate, very different ROI.
Production stack lifts L10 baseline by +2.17pp beat-rate and +3.54pp ROI on 2025-26 — gated ensemble + foul/blowout/heat-check residuals provide real value above naive.
